edit.description: The one home gains four builders and one widening, each placed in the family it belongs to. (1) The `edge` AssemblyFactRow builder — the set-taking form plus the single-target convenience over it, the shape `graph.rs:49 edge_to_set`/`graph.rs:43 edge` already have. (2) The routing-rule document, beside `scoped_rule` (:515) whose body it shares verbatim — one builder covering the `paths:`-scoped, `routes_to:`-routing and both-at-once spellings, so `graph.rs:1157 scoped_routing_rule` folds with its two siblings. (3) `intent_layout_row() -> LayoutRow` — keep the `_row` suffix: `layout_kind.rs:46 intent_layout` returns the engine `Layout`, so the bare name would read as its twin. Express its field region through the existing `field_region` (:877); it sits beside `layout_kind_facts` (:868), which already takes the region vec. (4) A one-required-clause engine `Contract` builder taking the kind name and the predicate, labelled through `contract::clause_label` — a new family beside the row-shaped `clause` (:936), which returns `ClauseRow` and cannot serve it. (5) `guard_in_band` (:393) takes the asserted `hookEventName`, so one envelope reader serves both the PreToolUse guard and the PostToolUse warn.

Four helpers reach `common`. `field_region` (:1464, 2 call sites) is byte-identical to `common::field_region` (:877) — delete it; it sits inside a `mod` block, which is why the prior fold's name census missed it (the import lands in that module). `edge_to_set` (:49, 6 call sites) and its `edge` wrapper (:43, 16 call sites) move. `routing_rule` (:30, 25 call sites) and `scoped_routing_rule` (:1157, 1 call site) move as the one rule-document builder. The intra-file `cited_lock`/`write_cited_harness` pairs (:2064/:2200, :2056/:2185) stay: distinct `mod` blocks, different bodies, one scenario each.

`edge` (:28, 2 call sites) builds exactly the row `edge_to_set(from, field, &[to])` yields — same signature, same `AssemblyFactRow`. 40c7158f's body listed this name as a divergent local that stays; that ruling does not survive a body comparison, and the entry that folds it says so. Reached as `common::edge` afterwards; the suite's local `requirement` (:60) returns the engine `Requirement`, not `common::requirement`'s row, and stays, as does its use of `common::field_region` (4 sites), already folded.

`edge_fact` (:2968, 9 call sites) is byte-identical to `graph.rs:49 edge_to_set` under another name — the copy the name-keyed census could not see. `routing_rule` (:3102, 1 call site) is byte-identical to `graph.rs:30` modulo its parameter name. Both reach `common`. `shapeless_hook_kind_facts` (:113) already struct-updates off `common::kind_facts` and stays — the format-less variant, the same call `bare_rule_kind_facts` makes.

`intent_layout_row` (:334, 2 call sites) is byte-identical to `read_verbs.rs:1127 intent_layout` — one renamed copy across two suites, and neither name reached the prior census's equality test. It reaches `common::intent_layout_row`; the suite's own `intent_layout` (:46), which returns the engine `Layout` this row is the wire form of, stays local.

The other copy of that LayoutRow: `intent_layout` (:1127) deletes in favour of `common::intent_layout_row`, renamed at the fold so it does not read as the sibling of `layout_kind.rs:46`'s engine-typed builder. The suite's `feature(id, satisfies)` and `explain` locals are untouched — the first was already ruled a non-alias at 40c7158f.

`post_edge_in_band` (:913, 3 call sites) differs from `common::guard_in_band` (:393) in exactly one assertion — `hookEventName` is `PostToolUse`, not `PreToolUse` — and one panic string. It deletes in favour of the widened `common::guard_in_band(output, event)`; the suite already calls that helper directly at :572, so the two spellings of one envelope reader sit five hundred lines apart in one file.

Three `common::guard_in_band` call sites (:1696, :1878, :2184) pass the asserted event — the fan-out of widening the shared helper rather than a fold of this suite's own scaffolding. No other change here.

`one_clause_contract` (:71) and `field_addressing.rs:26 contract` are one job — an engine `Contract` of exactly one required clause, labelled through `contract::clause_label`, differing only in the kind-name literal — written twice. It reaches the new `common` builder, passing its own name.

The other copy of that one-clause `Contract` (:26). Its local `findings` builder (:41) stays — 40c7158f ruled it divergent and a body comparison agrees, as it does for `closed_keys.rs`'s `clause`/`declares`/`closes` family (:21, :51, :61). `extent.rs:44 contract` (unit/max/whole, built from that suite's own `clause`) and `closed_keys.rs:32 contract` (a clause-vec wrapper) are different jobs and are not in scope.

summary: Six fixture builders are still spelled twice — a copy nested in a mod block, three renamed twins, and a one-assertion divergence the name-keyed census could not see.

tests.asserts: the suite's existing cases pass unchanged with `field_region`, the edge builders and the rule-document builder reached from `common` — its ~50 call sites across the four are the pin
the PostToolUse warn cases still read their finding out of `additionalContext` through the one widened envelope reader, and still fail if the envelope stamps the wrong event
the three PreToolUse guard cases keep asserting the PreToolUse envelope through the widened helper

acceptance: `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` green with each folded builder defined exactly once, in tests/it/common/mod.rs, and no integration suite redefining it — a body comparison of every non-test `fn` in tests/it/*.rs against that module finds no remaining byte-identical copy. No new assertion is possible for a pure consolidation; the commit body says so out loud, as 40c7158f's did, and names each same-name helper it left in place with the reason.
notes: Second pass on 40c7158f: that census matched helper *names*, so a copy nested in a `mod` block (graph's `field_region`), three renamed twins (`edge_fact`, `intent_layout_row`, `one_clause_contract`) and a one-assertion divergence (`post_edge_in_band`) survived it. Every item was verified by body comparison at HEAD. tests/it/install.rs is also named by INSTALL-LIFTS-A-REGISTRATION-MEMBER, which rests on an unresolved fork and cannot be in a wave with this. scoped at 80dbd411
